1775-6488-7186.description:

Deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures, dealing an increased amount of damage instead due to Collective Inferno.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the second indestructible creature due to Collective Inferno.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the first indestructible creature due to Collective Inferno.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve a Toralf trigger, dealing infinite damage to any target.
1775-6488-7186.notes: An example of the pre-requisite: If you give two creatures an opponent controls with toughness 2 and 3 indestructible, you would need to start the loop by dealing 4 noncombat damage to the creature with toughness equal to 2. This will deal 2 excess damage, which will be amplified to 4, thus dealing excess damage to the second creature and continuing the loop. It is recommended to start by giving the two smallest creatures possible indestructible and to target the smaller of the two creatures first.
